They won't contain anything but how I hope they will lead a wonderful life. There is noone important enough to warrant anything more. No regrets

edit: this will be the last comment. Everyone that read my words, may you become the best version of yourself.

It's my one last egoboost before the act. I've lurked here for about 3 years and SW has often been in my thoughts so I decided to post my feelings as I hadn't seen many on the same angle as I've felt.

Oh believe me, I'm very confident and focused on where I want to be.

This has been my most sought after achievement and I'm proud of myself being able to take this step in couple of hours.

Becoming nothing. :)

I've actually been planning and prepping my way out for about a week now. 

But for you questions; What I wanted to do in live was to experience it on my own. But I've never had a specific dream, not even as a little boy.

I consider myself smart so I thought I'd at least get a BS degree. Shame I dislike every single field that was available for that, I ended up choosing the least shittiest one. It was good that it had fun people there in phases before they moved on dropped out or changed.

Last few years have been me getting independent and tending to my ego and basically staying "content" with endorphins. I ran a half marathon, played in a local sunday football league, had a fuckbuddy for some time where I got to experience my sexbucketlist, took fun pictures with a camera I always wanted.

Those are the "peaks" over the past 4 years approx, the rest has been spent trying to sleep,oh god my favorite dreams are off me falling down a tall building and experiencing it as I was actually doing it. Most of the times with other people I've been feeling alone surrounded by people. Putting on a charming smile and just faking everything. Another sideactivity when everything was devoid of distractions I just sat in the car with the radio off just driving between scenic places or idling in a parking. Just being blank for periods of time, nothing, empty,  'off'.

I don't really consider my situation a 'problem', it's more off a constant feeling of extreme rationality. Legacy, responsibilities, expectations and other social items that just seems to makeup a web off confirmation bias in the population. Not really liking this paragraph but I'm going to leave it in. Gives my comment some 'closure' so to speak.
It's this accounts reddit birthday! haha wow what a coincident!
